_why: A clip that is PLAYED THROUGH the shared Template's mannequin foot-IK Control Rig pass must DRIVE that pass's effectors. CR_Mannequin_FootIK solves the deform foot ONTO ik_foot_l / ik_foot_r (measured in research/foot-ik-erratum.md with the trace off: it drives foot_l ONTO ik_foot_l, dL->0), so a clip whose ik_foot_* tracks are CONSTANT pins the foot exactly as a missing bone does. Khaimera's baked retarget clips carried 0.000/0.000/0.000 spans and the four-rig line-up take showed him planted while his arms swung. Rows here are the clips the roster actually plays through that pass.
_not_listed_on_purpose: The ORIGINAL /Game/MT/Khaimera/Retargeted/Khai_* clips are legitimately degenerate on these tracks (the IK Rig retarget chains never covered them) and are permanently off-limits to write — GoldenDiff.MTKhaimera and the six Verify.ClipVaries.Khai_* rows diff them. That is SIX clips, and naming them matters because four are still consumed at runtime: Khai_MF_Unarmed_Jog_Fwd and Khai_MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd are superseded for the render by the InPlace duplicates listed below, but Khai_MM_Idle, Khai_MM_Jump, Khai_MM_Fall_Loop and Khai_MM_Land are referenced directly by ABP_MT_Khaimera_InPlace's CDO and still carry DEAD ik_foot tracks. The foot-IK pass therefore still pins Khaimera's feet during Idle, Jump, Fall and Land. That is invisible in the four-rig line-up take (the shipped range is 25/25 samples of Locomotion, and a planted idle looks identical either way) and would be visible if he were ever shot jumping. khai_inplace_author.py verify() re-asserts that the two locomotion originals are STILL degenerate, which is the non-destructiveness proof; nothing here gates the four one-shots.
_thresholds_were_fixed_from_the_WORKING_:
minEffectorSpanCm 5.0 sits 3.75x below the SMALLEST real vertical span measured on any mannequin locomotion clip (the walk's 18.75 cm) and infinitely above the defect's 0.000.

maxEffectorDriftCm 0.05 and maxEffectorRotDeg 0.05 were RE-DERIVED after the original values were found to rest on a measurement that does not exist in the data. The authored mannequin effectors track their FK feet to a max of 0.0001 cm and 0.00103 deg over every key of both clips and both feet, reproduced across two separate runs; the baked InPlace rows measure 0.0000 cm. These bounds are therefore ~500x and ~49x the largest observed value, while the errors this assertion exists to catch are three to five orders of magnitude larger — the pre-bake defect measured 67-102 cm and 76-129 deg.

THE ORIGINAL BOUNDS (5.0 cm / 1.0 deg) were justified in writing as 'against a measured 2.96 cm max'. THAT 2.96 WAS AN ARTEFACT. It came from a throwaway probe reading poses via AnimationLibrary.get_bone_pose_for_frame, which APPLIES the skeleton's bone translation retargeting. On SK_Mannequin the FK leg chain (pelvis / thigh_l / calf_l / foot_l) is AnimationScaled while the ik_foot_root / ik_foot_l / ik_foot_r chain is Animation, so that probe composed a SCALED chain and compared it against an UNSCALED effector — a translation-only discrepancy, which is exactly why the rotation figures were correct and the translation ones were not. On Khaimera_Skeleton every bone in both chains is Animation, which is why the bake and this test agree to 0.0000 there. This test reads the RAW animation data model and is the authoritative measurement. A 5.0 cm bound would have let a 4 cm wrong-space error pass on the only two rows a fresh clone runs, which is the precise failure mode these thresholds exist to prevent.
